answers.text: Osmosis is water crossing a partially permeable membrane from high to low water concentration. Diffusion is particles moving from high to low concentration.

Plant cells have chloroplasts and a cell wall; animal cells have neither.
Photosynthesis happens in the chloroplasts where chlorophyll traps light energy to make glucose from carbon dioxide and water.
